acceptance: acceptance 指令把 ops/ios_test.sh 的真函式抽出來跑，但用一支「枚舉期偵測檔案被改動就提早收工」的假 xctestrun_target_env_roots 取代枚舉器，把原本 2/10 機率的競態變成必然。餵一份含兩個 BooksAndVocabUITests target 的 plist：今天迴圈體在讀完第一個 root 後就用 PlistBuddy 改檔，枚舉器偵測到 checksum 變了便停手，只數到 1 個 target，函式回 0（假通過），指令因此為紅。改成先快照再變更之後，枚舉在任何寫入前就跑完，兩個 target 都被數到，fail-closed 正確回 1，指令轉綠。已雙向實測：現況 stage_rc=0（紅），套上快照版實作 stage_rc=1（綠）。
acceptance_cmd: bash -c 'set -uo pipefail; test -f ops/ios_test.sh || exit 3; eval "$(sed -n "/^sanitize_xctestrun_evidence_env_root()/,/^}/p" ops/ios_test.sh)"; eval "$(sed -n "/^stage_live_demo_xctestrun()/,/^}/p" ops/ios_test.sh)"; xctestrun_target_env_roots() { local p="$1" i s0 s; s0=$(cksum < "$p"); printf ":TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:0:TestingEnvironmentVariables\n"; for i in $(seq 1 40); do s=$(cksum < "$p"); [[ "$s" != "$s0" ]] && return 0; sleep 0.05; done; printf ":TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:1:TestingEnvironmentVariables\n"; }; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT; b="$tmp/base.xctestrun"; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations array" "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0 dict" "$b" >/dev/null; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets array" "$b" >/dev/null; for t in 0 1; do /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:$t dict" "$b" >/dev/null; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:$t:BlueprintName string BooksAndVocabUITests" "$b" >/dev/null; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:$t:TestingEnvironmentVariables dict" "$b" >/dev/null; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :TestConfigurations:0:TestTargets:$t:TestingEnvironmentVariables:KG_LIVE_DEMO_RUN string spoof" "$b" >/dev/null; done; DEMO_ACCOUNT_IDENTITY_SHA256=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd; stage_live_demo_xctestrun "$b" "$tmp/s.xctestrun" >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "stage_rc=$rc" >&2; [[ $rc -eq 1 ]]'
detail: stage_live_demo_xctestrun enumerates xctestrun target roots through process substitution while the loop body rewrites the same plist with PlistBuddy. The producer intermittently misses the second target, so a duplicate BooksAndVocabUITests target returns success instead of fail-closed. Serial 10-run repro produced 1|0 twice and 1|1 eight times; the full fixture suite passed once then failed 1/378 on the next run.
plan: ops/ios_test.sh:1016 的 stage_live_demo_xctestrun 目前邊枚舉邊改同一份 plist。拆成兩段：先只收集，`local -a roots=(); while IFS= read -r env_root; do [[ -n "$env_root" ]] && roots+=("$env_root"); done < <(xctestrun_target_env_roots "$staged_path")`，此迴圈內不得有任何 PlistBuddy 寫入；再 `for env_root in "${roots[@]}"; do` 做 sanitize、讀 BlueprintName、計數。不可用 mapfile（/bin/bash 3.2 無此內建）。同時把 ops/test_ios_ops.sh:1382-1402 的 cardinality probe 換成 acceptance 用的那支決定性探針。
resolution: Owner: platform-steward after IMP-20260805-953840 review. Next action: snapshot env-root paths before any plist mutation in both live-demo and fixture staging, add deterministic regression for enumeration-before-mutation, then rerun ops/test_ios_ops.sh.
